Ledgerline Exports API — v2 (partner docs, section 4.3 "Reading export records")

GET {base}/v2/exports/{export_id}/records

Required headers
  Authorization: Bearer <access token>
  X-Ledgerline-Version: 2024-11-01
  Accept: application/json

Query parameters
  limit   integer, 1-200, default 50. Values above 200 are rejected with 400.
  cursor  opaque string returned as next_cursor by the previous page. Pass it back
          exactly as received (URL-encoded). Do not parse or construct cursors.

Response 200
  { "data": [ { "id": "rec_...", ... } ], "next_cursor": "..." | null }
  The listing is complete only when next_cursor is null. A page may contain zero
  records while next_cursor is non-null (the export is still being appended);
  clients MUST keep following the cursor.
  Because exports are appended while being read, a record may appear on two
  consecutive pages. Records are immutable; clients should de-duplicate by "id",
  keeping the first occurrence.

Errors and retries
  401       invalid or expired token. Do not retry.
  404       unknown export_id. Do not retry.
  400/422   malformed request. Do not retry.
  429       rate limited. The response carries Retry-After (integer seconds). Wait
            exactly that long, then repeat the same request. Up to 5 retries per
            request; after that surface the error.
  500, 502, 503, 504
            transient. Retry the same request with exponential backoff starting
            at 200 ms and doubling (200, 400, 800). At most 3 retries per request,
            then surface the error. Do not apply this backoff to 429.
  Any retry repeats the same cursor; never skip ahead.

Error surface (partner SDK conventions)
  Clients should raise LedgerAuthError for 401, LedgerNotFoundError for 404,
  LedgerRateLimitError when 429 retries are exhausted, and LedgerHttpError (with
  .status) for everything else. All errors carry the response's X-Request-Id as
  .requestId when the header is present.

events.claude: Understood, two separate policies: 429 means sleep(Retry-After × 1000), max 5 retries, then LedgerRateLimitError. 500/502/503/504 means sleep 200, 400, 800, max 3 retries, then LedgerHttpError with .status. 401 raises LedgerAuthError and 404 raises LedgerNotFoundError immediately. All of them get .requestId from X-Request-Id, and every retry repeats the same cursor.
